text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.N. says 187 companies from 32 countries have presented demands to buy Iraqi oil.
- Oil minister says no technical or political problems block the flow of Iraqi crude to international markets.
- U.S. allows American firms to buy Iraqi oil.
- Turkish troops continue violating Iraqi territory.
- Turkey to celebrate flow of Iraqi oil via its territory.
- Government issues harsher penalties on hard cash smugglers.
- Iraq and U.N. achieve big steps to solve outstanding issues on disarmament.
- Central Bank governor says government has no intention to change currency.
- Iraqi deputy prime minister receives Chinese official.
(The above were also carried by QADISSIYA and AL-IRAQ)
- Editorial lashes out at remarks by Jordanian information minister.
